conjoinApiKey.description: Conjoin API key for authenticated requests. Prefix with "Bearer " in the Authorization header.

conjoinPublishableKey.description: Conjoin publishable key, which starts with cpk_, for requests from a browser or a mobile app. Send it as "Bearer cpk_..." in the Authorization header.

conjoinSessionBearer.description: Conjoin Auth session access token. Send it as "Bearer <token>" in the Authorization header, or send the session cookie in its place.

conjoinSessionCookie.name: __conjoin_auth_sess
conjoinSessionCookie.description: Conjoin Auth session cookie that sign-in sets. The server reads it only when the Authorization header holds no Bearer token.

conjoinPortalTicketHeader.name: x-portal-ticket
conjoinPortalTicketHeader.description: The secret of the SSO setup portal link that an app administrator shares. Send it in this header, or in the ticket query parameter in its place.

conjoinPortalTicketQuery.name: ticket
conjoinPortalTicketQuery.description: The secret of the SSO setup portal link, as the link carries it. The server reads it ahead of the x-portal-ticket header.

scimBearer.description: SCIM directory bearer token for provisioning operations.

ConjoinRequestId.name: Conjoin-Request-Id
ConjoinRequestId.description: Optional customer-visible root operation identifier. Invalid, malformed, or missing values are replaced; the response header contains the effective Conjoin request ID.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A key that makes a retry of this request safe. A retry with the same key and the same request returns the first reply with the `Idempotent-Replayed: true` header and changes nothing. The same key with a different request answers 422, and a key whose first request is still being processed answers 409. The server keeps each key for 24 hours. An empty value counts as no key, so the server processes that request once for each time it arrives.

ConjoinRequestId.description: The effective customer-visible root operation identifier for this Conjoin API request.

IdempotentReplayed.description: The server sends this header when the reply is the stored first reply to a request with the same Idempotency-Key.
